articles.title: Replay review confirms goal-line stop as Texas Tech tops Houston - ESPN
articles.description: No. 13 Texas Tech held on for a 28-26 victory over No. 22 Houston as Cougars quarterback Conner Weigman came up just short on a 2-point conversion in the final minute.
